title: LineMarker
description: A parsed `<L>` slot. `first` is a signed number with sentinel meanings (0 = prepend anchor, -1 = append anchor). Decimals address the spaces between: in line contexts a fractional position inserts between lines (2.5 = after line 2); in result contexts a decimal in (0,1) is a similarity threshold for semantic matchers. `last` is the second position in a range marker, or null for a single-position marker.
